Who this is for (and not for)

Built for you if…

  • Can already ship simple sites and want clients, not tutorials
  • Want a fixed-price model instead of hourly billing
  • Willing to send 5–10 personalized pitches a day

Skip it if…

  • Want passive income with no outreach — this is a service business
  • Need guaranteed revenue figures — none are promised or implied
  • Want legal counsel — the contract is a template, not legal advice

FAQ

How do I receive the kit after paying?

Payment rails aren't live yet. Click Buy below to email us — we reply with the kit files and setup steps. Once checkout exists, delivery becomes instant download.

What skill level do I need?

Enough to ship responsive marketing sites and simple integrations (forms, booking embeds, payments), and the judgment to decline work beyond your level. The SOPs help you scope honestly.

Why $5 idea calls?

$5 removes friction for real prospects while filtering time-wasters. You deliver a written scope + fixed quote on the call; the $5 is credited toward the build if they proceed within 14 days.

Does the calculator need internet?

No. It's a single self-contained HTML file with inline CSS and JS — no CDNs, no tracking. Open it from your files on any browser, even offline.

Is the contract legally binding / legal advice?

No. It's a plain-language starting template with placeholder terms (scope, 50/50 payment, revisions, bug-fix window). Have a local attorney or legal clinic review it before use.

What does it cost to run this business?

The kit targets $0 in fixed tooling: free code/hosting tiers, existing email, free video calls. Clients pay their own domain/hosting. Your main investment is outreach time.
